claim: Initial conservative mapping. No scene/window is marked fully passed; partial means only named recorded branches. Test fixture outcomes never count as legitimate playthrough wins.

status_definitions.pending: No exact accepted engine case is mapped to this concrete class/branch yet. A static route or isolated unit test is insufficient.
status_definitions.partial: At least one exact recorded real-engine fixture branch is mapped; remaining branches and current-build retests are not implied.
status_definitions.not_applicable: Framework base with no standalone native user entry, with source basis. Its dispatch still needs concrete-scene tests.

constraints.formal_profiles: Do not launch, mutate or inspect private files of desktop-control/build/playthroughs profiles. Formal public traces are not substituted for engine fixtures here.
constraints.decision_boundary: Test setup may construct legal intermediate states only in test source sets. Subsequent actions use public NDJSON and current visible original controls. Internal same-version assertions never choose actions or targets.
constraints.query_purity: Audit writes are permitted; querying public state must not initialize game roots, change RNG/turn/UI/game data or construct information windows.
constraints.historical_evidence: Older P6/P7/layout fixtures predate the Chinese/windowed requirement. Their exact passed branches remain historical evidence; environment is not retroactively attested. New runs must satisfy the current locale/window contract.
constraints.evidence_binding: References bind to the recorded frozen runtime/profile and report pointer. Source changes require relevant reruns; no future build automatically inherits a pass.
